physical_limits: A passive fixed-anchor spring only redistributes or removes existing ringing energy; a new strike needs explicit source work.
4.8N fixes quasistatic triangle amplitude, not contact k, damping, anchor path, slip threshold or duration. Ratios used here are declared oracle stress cases, not production constants.
At an active source, physical velocity is incident plus outgoing on one side; the two stored outgoing waves must not be summed as the junction velocity.
Adjoint interpolation/deposition defines an extended discrete force port with effective instantaneous2Z/||g||^2. It is not an exact fractional point; moving weights require transport work.
Removing a preloaded spring removes its own storage; no unaccounted transfer into the string is allowed.

coherent_active_contact_and_current_pick.scope: Ideal integer lossless propagation, fixed endpoints and point contact. Production localized AP bank does not commute with ring-only gauge, as v4 proves.

wrong_port_passivity_counterexample.state: C[N-1]=+1m/s,C[j-1]=-1m/s,all others0; sumC=0 preserves fixed-end displacement compatibility.
wrong_port_passivity_counterexample.interpretation: A passive-looking force law driven by a non-conjugate gathered velocity can add energy. This is an exact ideal commuted-placeholder counterexample, not a claim about the complete production candidate or a fitted guitar state.

active_force_site_observation.note: Chosen algebraic input sample, not a pick trajectory.

coordinate_mapping.folded_edge_storage: P[k]=r[k] for0<=k<M;P[N-1-k]=-l[k]. Fixed-end propagation is cyclic shift.
coordinate_mapping.compact_gauge: C=-S_j P; current physical stateP=-S_-j C.
coordinate_mapping.changing_pick_position: Re-gauge all existing C byS_(jnew-jold), or retain fixed physicalP seam so no re-gauge is needed.
coordinate_mapping.pickup_cell_velocity: v_cell=P[e]-P[N-1-e], at cell center(e+.5)dx. At the active force node use incident+outgoing, not the two outgoing rays.
